# CurbSentry

> Private, local-first Automated License Plate Reader (ALPR) and neighborhood video security review software.

## Overview
CurbSentry processes user-selected video recordings locally in the web browser using client-side WebAssembly OCR (Tesseract.js). No footage, clips, license plates, timestamps, or personal data are ever transmitted to any remote cloud service or external API.

## Core Capabilities
- **A.L.P.R. Tool**: Optical Character Recognition on video frames and still camera photos directly inside the browser with pre-processing (grayscale, thresholding, invert, contrast).
- **Plate Lookup & 7-Day Trend Analytics**: Fast query interface for registered plates with interactive Recharts activity distributions and camera sighting breakdowns.
- **Repeat Sighting Rules**: Customizable threshold windows (default 24h, repeat count thresholds) and dedicated school-bus time protection windows.
- **Known Vehicles Exclusion**: Trusted household and neighbor cars are flagged and automatically excluded from suspicious repeat alert counts.
- **Export & Backup**: Full encrypted JSON backups, upload diagnostic reports, and CSV exports for known vehicle registries.
- **Privacy by Default**: Zero third-party cookies, zero telemetry, zero model API calls, full support for Global Privacy Control (GPC).

## Architecture & Compliance
- **Platform**: Universal Web SPA (React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS). Compatible with desktop browsers (Windows, Linux, macOS Intel and Apple Silicon) and mobile browsers (Android and iOS).
- **Data Security**: Sandboxed in-browser storage (localStorage / IndexedDB) with immediate one-click data deletion policy.
- **Security Headers**: HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, strict input sanitization.
